name: smwmusic-the-saturn-saturn-lifts-her-hands
title: The Saturn - Saturn Lifts Her Hands
description:
This is a song from an imaginary rom hack I've been brainstorming called "The Saturn", which I hope to one day actually create. This is supposed to be a last level theme, taking place in outer space (we dropping rhymes like dimes). It has a marching feel to it.

External samples are taken from Kirby's Dreamland 3 and Rudra no Hihou.

This theme's introduction is designed for a cutscene. The main loop is designed for actual level gameplay.
